name: agent-gw-frontend
description: Alfred PWA frontend — Markdoc content engine + design system, bundled with esbuild.

scripts.build: node build/registry.mjs && esbuild src/main.js --bundle --format=iife --global-name=Alfred --minify --outfile=dist/engine.js && esbuild src/launcher/main.js --bundle --format=iife --minify --outfile=dist/launcher.js && NODE_PATH=./node_modules esbuild ../plugins/scan/web/decodeur.js --bundle --format=iife --minify --outfile=dist/scan.js && esbuild src/atelier/cli.js --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=dist/atelier.mjs && (cp dist/atelier.mjs ../plugins/atelier/tools/atelier.mjs 2>/dev/null || true)
scripts.test: node build/registry.mjs && node test/registry-test.mjs && node test/atelier-test.mjs && node test/render-test.mjs && node test/parcours-test.mjs && node test/chart-test.mjs && node test/scan-test.mjs && node test/scan-decode-test.mjs && node test/theme-lint.mjs
